text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 461 单元

quaker
音标：英 /'kweikə/  美 /'kweikə/
n. 教友派信徒, 贵格会会员

alternately
音标：英 /ɔːl'tɜːnɪtlɪ/  美 /'ɔltɚnɪtli/
adv. 交替地,轮流地
例句：The idea is that if a gravitational wave passes through GEO600, it will alternately stretch space in one direction and squeeze it in another.
其基本原理是，当引力波经过GEO600时，它将交替地在一个方向上拉伸空间，在另一个方向上挤压空间。

thermodynamic
音标：英 /,θɜːməʊdaɪ'næmɪk/  美 /,θɝmodaɪ'næmɪks/
adj. 热力学的, 使用热动力的
短语：thermodynamic system — 热力学体系；热力学系统

短语：thermodynamic cycle — 热力循环，热动力循环
例句：After that, the formalism of statistical mechanics takes over, and calculates partition functions and thermodynamic functions.
从那以后，都是统计力学的内容，计算配分函数,和热力学函数。
例句：That is, in terms of equations of state. For any material Then we would really be able to essentially calculate anything. Anything thermodynamic.
换句话说，利用任何一种物质的状态方程,我们就能够实质上,计算所有物理量，所有热力学量。
例句：This must be brought into the picture, along with the performance of thermodynamic work cycles that link spontaneous and non-spontaneous processes like an engine.
